releases.notes:
## 更新日志

- 枪械类别添加精确射手步枪
- 添加创造栏物品，使用资源位置`customguntab:{创造栏类别}_icon`（如`customguntab:ar_icon`）
- 枪械索引、子弹索引添加`hide_in_game`字段

修复：
- 修复物品在物品展示框渲染为物品栏贴图时水平镜像

开发者：
- 使用`GunCategory`的代码需要重新编译

# English

- Add Designated Marksman Rifle (DMR) to gun category
- Add creative tab items using resource location `customguntab:{tab_category}_icon` (e.g. `customguntab:ar_icon`)
- Add `hide_in_game` to gun index, ammo index

Fix:
- Fixed horizontal mirroring when items are rendered as inventory slot textures in item frames

For Developer:
- Recompile any code that uses `GunCategory`

# Release notes

## What's Changed
* Tab icon by @XColorful in https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/pull/80
* Remove built-in creative tab icon pack by @XColorful in https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/pull/85


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/compare/26.10.31...26.10.32
